options.name: comments
options.description: A comment to apply to the Harness Template (version).

options.name: description
options.description: A description to apply to the Harness Template (version).

options.name: git_details
options.description: The details about where to store the Template. Generally either INLINE or REMOTE. And if REMOTE then specify more details about the REMOTE target.

options.name: identifier
options.description: Identifier of the Harness Template. Make sure the template_yaml content matches.

options.name: org
options.description: Identifier of the Harness Organization to which the Template will belong. Make sure the template_yaml content matches.

options.name: project
options.description: Identifier of the Harness Project to which the Template will belong. Make sure the template_yaml content matches.

options.name: state
options.description: Desired state of the Harness Template.

options.name: template_yaml
options.description: The template_yaml with which to build the Harness Template. Be careful as these values can override module parameters.
